def fn(t0, t1, t2, ta, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t2[-3, :2:3]
    v2 = t1.unfold(0, 11, 15)
    v3 = ta[4::3, :]
    v4 = v2[:, :]
    ta[5] = 2
    v5 = torch.roll(t1, 1, 0)
    v6 = v5.unsqueeze(0)
    idx7 = torch.tensor([0], device=v4.device)
    v4[idx7] += 0
    return (v5, t0, v3, lst, dct)
